hard_case: The bare `render(..)` calls reach the changed `b::render` only through the raw-spelled leaf `use crate::b::r#render;`, while a glob of `a` offers a namesake.

mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: `b::render(5)` becomes true and `assert_eq!(render(5), false)` fails. Run under rustc 1.95.0 with `cargo test` on the edited subject: tests_failed in tests::renders_through_b.

reasoning: The raw leaf binds the plain name `render` to `b::render` (#14087), so `assert_eq!(render(5), false)` pins the changed boundary exactly. Before the fix the glob namesake `a::render` took the call and this change lost its credit (limited).
